chapter: Big Eye Nelson, Lutton's and Adams
title: Substituting with Big Eye Louis Nelson's four-piece band
summary: He subbed for the band's pianist and then worked regularly with Nelson's four-piece, faking by ear. He left after a dispute over tips.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: And then we had something about Big L.O. Nelson too, you played with him.
Oh yeah, well I wasn't a regular member of that band. I used to play and substitute for their piano player.
Oh, she was playing piano with him. I know Walter Pichon was playing with him a while. That kind of thing was playing piano with him. The Draft team you're talking about? No, this was a big band.
No, I'm talking about Big I. Lou Nelson. Oh, Big I. Lou.
I'm talking about Lloyd. See there's two Nelsons, John. Yeah, yeah, yeah. No, I'm talking about that. Oh, that was a small band, Four Pieces. You worked regularly with that band?
Oh yeah, I worked regularly with that band. Oh yeah, I worked regularly with that band.
It's been a while with him. That was Peter Borkage, Ernest Rodger, Louie Nelson and myself. Four Pieces down there. That was Big I? Yeah, Big I.
Yeah. That was just a fake band?
You didn't read it? No, I didn't read the music.
He used to bring little piano schools like that, you know. Oh, like if they wanted to hit a certain tune.
Yeah. New numbers like that, you know. How was Big I. Lou Nelson as the band leader? He was all right.

He was all right. The only time we had a little misunderstanding was the time that the guy gave me a tip to play a certain number for him, you see. And he had to gain a few tips, but I had received this man's money before he received his money. And so I called him about a couple of times and he said he wasn't going to play and I walked off the job. That's what Paul and I really had. I never took back after that.
He wouldn't play the song for the man? No, he was playing the ones that he had.

You see the different requests, see if he wants to give you a request, he'll give you a request. But by you being the leader, well you the boss, you have to say you played what you want. I couldn't, I had to just wait until he got ready to play for it.
But the tips all went into one kitty.

Oh yeah, one kitty, yeah. The tip was more than Sarah. Yeah, he used to make a job. Never did play anything. A legend. A legend, man. I think that legend was going to get about a dollar and a half a night, but the tip runs about fifteen to twenty dollars. You only had four pieces.
